summary: Retrieve artists and their albums with filtering options
description: Returns a list of artists (optionally with their albums) and allows filtering, sorting and pagination. The `client_id` query parameter is required. Use `fullcount=true` only when necessary as it may impact performance. The `callback` parameter works only with JSON responses and GET requests.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a JavaScript callback (JSONP). Works only with JSON format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' returns up to 200 rows.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field(s). Append `_asc` or `_desc` to set direction. Ascending is default, but popularity fields force descending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, response header includes `results_fullcount` with the total row count without pagination.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs to filter.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search for artists containing the given substring.

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists that have an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter artists by joining date. Format: yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd (from_to).

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: One or more album IDs to filter.

parameters.name: album_datebetween
parameters.description: Filter albums by release date. Format: yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Size of the album cover image in pixels.

notes: The `order` parameter defaults to ascending; popularity fields always use descending order even if `_asc` is specified.
`fullcount` can degrade performance and is not available on heavy methods.
`callback` is ignored for non‑JSON formats or non‑GET requests.
